conditional_math.statement: For a family O of tests T:B->Y_T, active-only representation N is adequate for all O iff each test is constant on every fiber of N.
conditional_math.preconditions: set-sized well-typed A,B; N:B->A is surjective with a canonical section i; each T is a function
conditional_math.proof: apply P45 factorization separately to each T; uniqueness of Tbar from surjectivity

conditional_math.statement: The existence of raw preservation in B does not imply that an external evidence field E is determined by a raw presentation.
conditional_math.preconditions: an independent external ledger coordinate e with at least two values and no function E(B) specified
conditional_math.proof: the pairs (P,e1) and (P,e2) have exactly the same raw P but different e; projection to P cannot recover e
conditional_math.verification_scope: external-ledger counterexample, not a claim of an existing DSD requirement

conditional_math.statement: Raw strict may refine active strict without matching the task-specific observational equivalence; finer alone is not objectively more correct.
conditional_math.preconditions: raw strict includes active comparison plus optional typed extra coordinates; active-only observer suite
conditional_math.proof: two presentations with same N and distinct raw extras are active observationally equivalent, yet non-raw-isomorphic in index-sensitive B2
conditional_math.verification_scope: conditional countermodel and logical distinction, not comparative practical effectiveness

conditional_math.statement: Neither retention of optional raw fields nor typed inclusion ensures a valid activation transition when declaration/profile availability changes.
conditional_math.preconditions: P27 is fixed-signature static; no transition rule given
conditional_math.proof: a raw Xi_q may exist without raw Ap_q, while declaring q requires a typed active Ap_q and PI/PII; the naive transition can be ill-typed or axiom-inadmissible
conditional_math.verification_scope: single finite countermodel under hypothetical B typing

conditional_math.statement: If a specific task only observes active PAS content, A and B1 produce identical PAS-level observational results after N, even when raw presentation differs.
conditional_math.preconditions: task tests factor through N, no separate provenance criteria queried
conditional_math.proof: T(P)=Tbar(N(P)) for all tests by M48-1; cannot infer full historical equality of distinct raw presentations
conditional_math.verification_scope: derived from M48-1, not a total equivalence of methods
